name: Fatigue, Fracture & Creep
summary: How and when components fail under cyclic loads, cracks and high temperature, and how engineers design and inspect against it.

topics.name: Stress-life (S-N) approach: endurance limit and modifying factors
Notches: fatigue notch factor and notch sensitivity
Strain-life approach: Coffin-Manson, cyclic stress-strain, Neuber's rule
Variable-amplitude loading: rainflow counting and Miner's rule
Linear elastic fracture mechanics: stress intensity factor and fracture toughness
Elastic-plastic fracture mechanics: CTOD and the J-integral
Fatigue crack growth (Paris law) and damage-tolerant design
Fatigue of welded joints and multiaxial fatigue
Creep, stress rupture, Larson-Miller parameter and creep-fatigue interaction
Environmental effects: corrosion fatigue, hydrogen embrittlement, fretting
Nondestructive inspection for cracks (ultrasonic, magnetic particle, dye penetrant, eddy current, radiography)
